settings.description:
The PRANA AI Skin Scan is an intelligent skin analysis tool designed to create personalized skincare rituals based on your unique skin type, condition, and Ayurvedic dosha balance.

Using just a simple selfie, our technology examines texture, hydration, tone, and elasticity to identify your skin’s needs — then pairs these findings with Ayurveda’s holistic understanding of energy, balance, and elements.
This isn’t just another beauty quiz — it’s a fusion of ancient science and modern innovation, translating centuries of Ayurvedic knowledge into measurable, actionable skincare guidance.

settings.heading: What Is the PRANA AI Skin Scan?

settings.title: 1. Scan Your Skin
settings.description: Upload a clear, natural-light photo through our secure platform.

settings.title: 2. AI Analysis
settings.description: Our machine-learning engine evaluates over a dozen parameters, including brightness, hydration, fine lines, and micro-texture.

settings.title: 3. Ayurvedic Mapping
settings.description: The system overlays the analysis with dosha assessment — identifying whether your skin reflects Vata, Pitta, or Kapha tendencies.

settings.title: 4. Personalized Ritual Recommendation
settings.description: Instantly receive your custom Ayurvedic skincare ritual, featuring targeted Prana Beauty products like our Saffron Radiance Serum, Bakuchiol Renewal Serum, and Turmeric & Sandalwood Mask
